test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

Z _ _ M I _ C B _ I Z C _ M _ Z C _ _ I

options.text: C B Z B I M B M
C B Z M B I B M
C B Z I B M B M
C B Z B M I B M

solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) Z *__**C B**__* M I / *__**Z**__* C B *__**B**__* I / Z C *__**I**__* M *__**M**__* / Z C *__**B M**__* I → doesn't follow any pattern

2) Z *__C B__* M I / *__Z__* C B *__M__* I / Z C *__B__* M *__I__* / Z C *__B M__* I → follows a pattern (ZCBMI)

3) Z *__C B__* M I / *__Z__* C B *__I__* I / Z C *__B__* M *__M__* / Z C *__B M__* I → doesn't follow any pattern

4) Z *__C B__* M I / *__Z__* C B *__B__* I / Z C *__M__* M *__I__* / Z C *__B M__* I→ doesn't follow any pattern

Hence, the correct answer is "**C B Z M B I B M**".
